planted_issues: blown highlights in harsh vertical midday sun
must_mention: expose for the highlights; wait for shade-edge light; protect the white channel

planted_issues: tilted horizon and lifeless midday sky
must_mention: level the horizon; return at golden hour; use the rule-of-thirds horizon placement

planted_issues: missed focus on the eyes (focus fell on the ear)
must_mention: use eye-detect AF; nail focus on the near eye; open shade for catchlights

planted_issues: depth of field too shallow so only one petal edge is sharp
must_mention: stop down to f8-f11; focus-stack; steady on a tripod

planted_issues: converging verticals (keystoning) from tilting the camera up
must_mention: keep the sensor plane parallel; correct verticals; shoot from further back

planted_issues: lurid clipped greens from Color +2 on the neon signage
must_mention: dial Color to 0 or -1; expose for the brightest neon; embrace the reflections

planted_issues: flat frontal flash killing texture and shadow
must_mention: use side window light; add a single diffused source; rake the light across the dish

planted_issues: motion blur from no tripod during the 2s exposure
must_mention: use a tripod; trigger with self-timer; bring an ND filter for daylight

planted_issues: heavy luminance noise from ISO 12800 single frame
must_mention: lower ISO and stack frames; use the 500-rule shutter; shoot RAW for noise headroom

planted_issues: cluttered background competing with the graphic subject
must_mention: simplify the frame; isolate one shape; use negative space
